data.name: Manish
data.gender_notes: Manish is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit manas, 'mind', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the mind'. Its root is Sanskrit manas + īśa. A classical Sanskrit name. Manish is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the mind; wise”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Manish expresses “Lord of the mind; wise”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit manas, 'mind', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the mind'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manish total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
